text: The ___ transform converts a linear constant-coefficient ODE with given initial conditions into an algebraic equation by turning differentiation into multiplication by s.
explanation: The Laplace transform uses L{f'} = s*F(s) - f(0), so a differential equation becomes algebraic in F(s); inverting recovers the solution. It handles discontinuous and impulsive forcing (Heaviside step, Dirac delta) with particular ease.
